parsed.explanation: Reduced risk. No documented traveler-facing trans-specific criminalization, border refusal, facility ban, or care denial. Goods/services anti-discrimination protections cover all regions, legal texts include gender identity/expression, hate-crime aggravation exists, and there is a prison rights framework. Positive climate signals include marriage equality, third-marker recognition, military openness, pride visibility, and substantial public support. Downweights are that current enforcement, facility/service acceptance, and actual trans detention placement are not evidenced; trans-specific violence magnitude is unresolved despite a 2025 anti-LGBT ambush network, under-counted hate violence, conservative Catholic influence, and a strong far-right party. No universal exclusion or state targeting is documented, but incomplete proof of protection keeps it below low-risk.
